verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly documents CI/CD experiments to 'block deploys on regressions' and states 'Use Langfuse experiments in your CI/CD pipeline to catch quality regressions before they ship,' alongside dataset-based experiments, code evaluators, and LLM-as-a-judge scoring that feed into gating decisions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the CI gating workflow in practice and details on how the pass/fail threshold is configured/enforced.
